source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Install/configure Linux Board Production Suite and run `./tserver -boardtest=extmfg` 100 times.
procedure_facts: Step 4 literally says repeat installation, adding all items, and execution (steps 1-3) 100 times.
Machine time is 3000 minutes (50 hours), averaging 30 minutes per cycle if all 100 cycles are intended.
criteria_facts: Every item PASS and dmesg/lspci BDF UCE, CE, Fatal and non-fatal status normal.
source_conflicts: Title implies 100 test runs, but procedure literally repeats installation/configuration as well as the run 100 times.
missing_source_information: Whether install/config is once or per iteration; exact BPS item set, package/config/version, AER counter semantics and stop policy.

original_test_intent.statement: Complete 100 BPS extmfg stress iterations and demonstrate every enabled board-production item passes without new PCIe correctable, uncorrectable, fatal or non-fatal error evidence.
must_preserve: Exactly 100 successful test iterations and 3000-minute planned machine time.
Exact tserver command, complete item results and per-BDF error evidence.
must_not_infer: That cumulative CE counters must be zero rather than unchanged from baseline unless the spec says so.
That a final aggregate PASS proves all 100 iterations.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 preserves 100 command iterations, per-pass results/error scans, stop-on-first-error, history and thermal/watchdog safeguards.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 silently resolves the source's `repeat 1~3` into one installation/configuration followed by 100 runs; it also does not distinguish cumulative PCIe AER baselines/deltas from raw nonzero counters.

related_records: No other BPS record defines whether this package/config must be rebuilt for every cycle.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The 100-run title and literal step range conflict must be returned to the owner; V3 cannot silently rewrite the repetition boundary.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Do not start the 50-hour stress until the owner states whether steps 1-2 occur once or in every cycle. In either interpretation, require 100 distinct extmfg run records and per-iteration BPS/AER deltas with stop-on-first anomaly.

conditions_present: Exact command, 100 count, 3000-minute plan and error categories.
missing: Repetition boundary, signed BPS package/config/item list, per-item expectations, BDF inventory/AER method, timeouts and recovery.
provider: Test owner resolves install/config cadence and supplies acceptance recipe.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory board/GPU/BDF topology, current package state, enabled config if present, AER capabilities/counters, logs, thermals and storage without clearing or executing BPS.
prohibited_until_resolved: Installing/reinstalling BPS, changing config, starting iterations, clearing error history, auto-retrying or PASS.
closure_evidence: Written cadence decision plus immutable package/config/item manifest and per-iteration evidence/abort plan.

revision_candidate.purpose: Execute 100 complete `extmfg` BPS test iterations and verify every configured item passes on every iteration without new per-BDF PCIe CE, UCE, fatal or non-fatal errors or other board/GPU/system faults.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact supported AMD GPU board/server, Linux, driver/firmware and signed Linux Board Production Suite release/configuration. The owner must resolve whether package installation and configuration occur once before the series or are intentionally repeated each cycle.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Exactly 100 separately identified `./tserver -boardtest=extmfg` executions over the approved full item list and all affected PCIe BDFs, using the source's 3000-minute total machine-time plan. No failed or missing iteration may be replaced silently.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Written install/config repetition decision; signed BPS package/version/checksum; support matrix; immutable full item list/config hash; item expectations; BDF/device map; AER/dmesg counter baseline and delta rules; per-iteration timeout/cleanup; 50-hour thermal/power/storage/watchdog plan; maintenance, abort and recovery approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture immutable configuration and baseline device/BDF, AER, dmesg, BMC/SEL, thermal and power state. Perform install/configuration at the owner-approved cadence. For iteration 1 through 100, invoke exactly `./tserver -boardtest=extmfg`, retain command/status and every item result, collect timestamped per-BDF AER/dmesg deltas before advancing, and stop at the first non-PASS, new disallowed counter/event, timeout or health limit. Produce a gap-free 1..100 ledger and final health comparison.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Repetition ambiguity resolved; package/config/items verified; all targets healthy/idle; adequate evidence capacity; watchdog, telemetry, console/OOB, abort and restoration available; approval recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Cadence decision; package/config hashes and item manifest; OS/driver/firmware/topology/BDF baseline; exact command for each numbered iteration; per-item results; start/end/status; per-BDF raw AER counters plus baseline/delta and decoded CE/UCE/fatal/non-fatal events; dmesg/BMC/SEL deltas; thermal/power telemetry; stop/watchdog events; gap-free 100/100 summary and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Approved BPS item recipe and platform PCIe/error policy. Pass requires 100 completed non-retried iterations, every enabled item PASS each time, no prohibited new error delta/event and healthy final state; aggregate PASS or iteration count alone is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not guess the install cadence, repeatedly mutate packages unless explicitly required, clear error history between runs, continue after the first fault, relabel a retry as the same iteration, omit a BDF/item, exceed limits or infer raw cumulative counters without baseline/delta context.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner resolves cadence and approves package/items/error rules; lab approves 50-hour load and recovery; engineer judges CE policy and any anomaly.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent can execute/monitor/package evidence after approval; recipe applicability, repetition meaning and anomaly disposition remain human decisions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On the first item/error/timeout/thermal/power fault, stop new iterations, terminate only approved processes, preserve that and prior ledgers, return the system to the approved package/config and idle state, verify all devices/links and escalate before any retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Cadence unresolved; unsigned/unsupported BPS; item/BDF/error policy missing; config drift; insufficient storage/monitoring/recovery; non-PASS item; new disallowed CE/UCE/fatal/non-fatal/AER event; reset/link loss; timeout; thermal/power breach; incomplete iteration evidence.

identified_defects: Repetition boundary conflicts with the title.
AER raw counters lack baseline/delta semantics.
No immutable item manifest or gap-free iteration ledger.
reason_for_change: Retain all 100 stress runs while refusing to invent whether installation and configuration must also occur 100 times.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-AMD GPU-00227-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: Literal repeat steps 1-3, exact command, 100 count and 3000-minute time.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The intended installation/configuration cadence is unresolved.

removed_ambiguities: Makes cadence an explicit owner decision.
Defines 100 distinct command executions and non-retried ledger.
Requires per-BDF counter deltas rather than context-free values.
resolved_blockers: Tool/config provisioning and 50-hour duration do not inherently prevent automation.
remaining_blockers: Cadence, package/config/items, error policy and approval remain absent.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 exposes rather than silently repairs `repeat 1~3`, while preserving 100 command runs and adding a gap-free per-iteration ledger with baseline-relative PCIe error evidence.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator preserved the unresolved setup cadence, exactly 100 distinct non-retried extmfg runs, 3000 minutes as total planning time, and per-iteration BPS plus baseline-relative AER evidence.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 234 says repeat installation, add-all-items and extmfg execution 100 times over 3000 minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 assumed one setup plus 100 runs; V3 returns the setup cadence for decision and preserves 100 runs explicitly.
